SELECT
  p.id,
  p.provider,
  p.parent_ref,
  p.poi_id,
  p.active,
  p.next_run_at,
  p.claimed_until,
  p.last_run_at,
  COALESCE(run_stats.current_failure_streak, 0) AS current_failure_streak,
  po.cadence_override_sec AS poi_cadence_override_sec,
  p.last_force_pull_at,
  p.created_at,
  p.updated_at
FROM availability_poller p
JOIN pois po ON po.id = p.poi_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE terminal_runs.status = 'failed')::int AS current_failure_streak
  FROM (
    SELECT
      r.status,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'completed') OVER (
        ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.id DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
      ) AS prior_completed_runs
    FROM availability_run r
    WHERE r.poller_id = p.id
      AND r.status IN ('completed', 'failed')
  ) terminal_runs
  WHERE COALESCE(terminal_runs.prior_completed_runs, 0) = 0
) run_stats ON true
WHERE COALESCE((ARRAY[${poller_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND p.id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${poller_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '');

SELECT
  w.id AS watch_id,
  w.status AS watch_status,
  CASE
    WHEN count(DISTINCT wt.id) = 0 THEN NULL
    WHEN count(DISTINCT wt.id) FILTER (WHERE wt.poi_id IS NOT NULL) > 0
     AND count(DISTINCT wt.id) FILTER (WHERE wt.campsite_id IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN 'mixed'
    WHEN count(DISTINCT wt.id) FILTER (WHERE wt.poi_id IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN 'poi'
    ELSE 'campsite'
  END AS scope,
  count(DISTINCT wt.id) AS target_count,
  array_agg(
    DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN wt.poi_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'poi:' || wt.poi_id::text
      WHEN wt.campsite_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'campsite:' || wt.campsite_id::text
    END
  ) FILTER (WHERE wt.id IS NOT NULL) AS scope_ids,
  w.campsite_filters,
  w.start_date,
  w.end_date,
  w.cadence_sec,
  w.trigger_kinds,
  w.stop_when_triggered,
  count(DISTINCT p.id) AS pollers,
  min(p.next_run_at) FILTER (WHERE p.active) AS next_run_at,
  max(p.last_run_at) AS last_run_at,
  w.created_at
FROM availability_watch w
LEFT JOIN availability_watch_poller wp ON wp.watch_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN availability_poller p ON p.id = wp.poller_id
LEFT JOIN availability_watch_target wt ON wt.watch_id = w.id
GROUP BY w.id, w.status, w.campsite_filters, w.start_date, w.end_date, w.cadence_sec, w.trigger_kinds, w.stop_when_triggered, w.created_at
ORDER BY (w.status = 'active') DESC, next_run_at ASC NULLS LAST;

SELECT started_at AS time, id AS run_id, status, duration_ms, snapshot_count
FROM availability_run
WHERE COALESCE((ARRAY[${poller_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND poller_id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${poller_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')
ORDER BY started_at ASC;
